summary: @servicetitan/widget-platform preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that on `npm install` downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a ~727 KB sibling file named `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with heavy string-array-rotation obfuscation (rotator function shuffling a large constant array, hex-encoded identifiers) and has no relation to the package's advertised widget-platform purpose — it is not referenced by any code under `dist/` or `src/`. The alternate-runtime execution path (Bun instead of Node) causes the payload to bypass Node-based inspection, and the cover name `math_init.js` and the `@servicetitan` scope do not match the shipped behavior. Installing this version causes attacker-controlled, opaque code to run automatically on the installer's machine with the user's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
